source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi Shashank,

I've completely reworked the concept based on your feedback rather than just editing the previous version.

This version is now structured as a 30-second, fast-paced testimonial-style UGC ad with multiple Indian testimonials, so it doesn't feel like a copy of the winning creative while still using the same high-converting keywords and psychology.

I focused on the points you highlighted:

- Stronger, more direct hook

- Fresh concept instead of copying the reference

- Testimonial-style execution

- Faster pacing suitable for Meta

- Keywords built around energy, confidence, stamina and performance

- Indian actors with appropriate visual flow and editing opportunities


Please review it and let me know if this is aligned with the direction you're looking for before I move on to the final production prompt and scene-by-scene execution.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports reworking the concept with faster pacing suitable for Meta.
